assignment: Foundation 2.1 E07 widget and App Intent acceptance

reproductions: A ready opaque shortcut followed immediately by backgrounding reactivated private routing, presented a pickup and republished an opaque widget handle.
The same sequence through a generic shortcut reactivated routing, presented the grocery editor and republished an opaque widget handle.
The first synchronous generic candidate lost the contributor’s own-request destination during binding reconciliation. The final candidate preserves it for the same live persona and clears it on lock.

ready_url_privacy_follow_up.warm_widget: RacesWarmWidget.xcresult passed. The real Home Screen tile opened the grocery entry editor with the app running.

shortcut_screen_refresh.scope: Opening the Device Shortcuts screen or retrying its refresh reconciles the current scene state. The ordinary UI case verified the Shop entry touch target and returned to Shop. The separate ready URL tests cover the route and widget publication races.

cold_presentation_follow_up.source_difference: The integrated composition retains the existing one-line comment from the current-pickup guard. The tested executable logic and startup tests match the reviewed patch.
cold_presentation_follow_up.diagnosis: The root received the cold link after binding while the scene was inactive and the stores were loading. The adult workspace was unlocked. The inactive check rejected the opaque link before it could be queued, and reconciliation cleared the temporary unavailable destination.
cold_presentation_follow_up.direct_routes: Cold current opened the current pickup, generic opened grocery entry, and stale opened the unavailable screen. All three preserved the selected pickup, ledger revision and saved workspace.
cold_presentation_follow_up.cold_system_widget: ColdFixedWidget.xcresult passed. Tapping the Home Screen widget after confirming app termination opened the current pickup’s saved list. The screenshot and accessibility output identify E07 current B and its saved line.
cold_presentation_follow_up.warm_system_widget: WarmFixedWidget.xcresult passed. Tapping the Home Screen widget with the app running opened Bring the list. The screenshot and accessibility output identify the editor.
cold_presentation_follow_up.workspace_readback: Both actual widget taps retained the current pickup and revision 8. The full workspace and shop payloads match. The widget’s generic exterior can render either the current route or the generic entry across timeline refreshes.
remaining: Delayed physical WidgetKit refresh and locked shortcut tasks

retained_route_follow_up.warm_baseline: Opening the saved A URL and accepting the iOS prompt switched selection from B to A. The ledger revision advanced from 3 to 4 and both shop payloads stayed byte-identical.
retained_route_follow_up.warm_fixed: The retained A URL showed the unavailable entry. The current B URL opened B’s saved list. B stayed selected, the revision stayed at 6, and the entire workspace hash matched before and after both probes.
retained_route_follow_up.cold_fixed: Both saved URLs opened Shop after termination. The selected pickup, revision and workspace hash were preserved. Direct cold navigation to the current list remains open.

system_widget.placement: FixedWidgetPlacementFinal.xcresult passed with one test. The generic tile was added through the system gallery while A was selected.
system_widget.warm_tap: WarmActualWidget.xcresult passed with one test. After the ordinary app selected B, tapping the existing Home Screen tile opened Bring the list. The selection, revision 8 and workspace hash matched before and after.
system_widget.cold_tap: ColdActualWidget.xcresult failed with one test. After app termination the system tile launched Shop and the expected route content stayed absent. The selection, revision 8 and workspace hash matched before and after.
system_widget.scope: The saved URL probes establish stale-handle behavior. The system widget tests establish delivery from the Home Screen. The sealed report preserves the original placement harness failures and keyboard-service recovery on the disposable simulator.
